reason: W17, W18, and B0 share V3 recorder semantics with timestamp_received plus sequence.
V2 lacks recoverable sequence for equal receive timestamps and AG6 is a separate acquisition stratum.
Pooling source versions before proving transportability would trade sample size for chronology ambiguity.
v2_ag6_policy: Do not pool V2/AG6 into candidate selection or B0 evaluation. Before the experiment-wide PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE, record source-stratified replication for every V3 survivor wherever exact hash+token linkage and strict pre-trade receive ordering are supportable. Equal-time V2 states are excluded as AMBIGUOUS. If a source stratum is not chronologically testable, record UNTESTABLE_SOURCE rather than imputing evidence.
deployment_implication: Every B0 survivor remains FUTURE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED until genuinely future/live confirmation; source-specific failures further restrict transportability and MM use.
v1_policy: No sequential fill claims without an exact venue trade anchor.

pre_holdout_source_rule.candidate_selection_source: V3 W17 TRAIN / W18 DEV only
pre_holdout_source_rule.v2_ag6_effect_on_b0_eligibility: Does not add candidates or change frozen V3 thresholds. Negative source-stratified replication marks SOURCE_SPECIFIC / FUTURE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED but does not by itself invalidate a same-source one-shot B0 test. Untestable source strata are explicit.
